description: Header file defining the em_orch_ctrl_t class, which extends em_orch_t to provide orchestration control functionalities such as building candidates, pre-processing operations, cancellation, readiness checks, and transient command handling in a network orchestration context.

classes.name: em_orch_ctrl_t
classes.description: A class extending em_orch_t that manages orchestration control operations including candidate building, pre-processing, validation, and transient command handling.

methods.name: build_candidates
methods.description: Builds a list of candidate configurations based on the provided command.

methods.name: pre_process_orch_op
methods.description: Pre-processes the orchestration operation prior to execution.

methods.name: pre_process_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing pre-processing of a command.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_exec
methods.description: Checks if the EM is ready for orchestration execution.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_fini
methods.description: Determines if the EM is ready for orchestration finalization.

methods.name: em_orch_ctrl_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the orchestration control with a manager structure.
